series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2018, 20 percent of business content will be authored by machines.
entries.subject: Machine-written business content
entries.metric: share of business content authored by machines

entries.quote: By 2018, six billion connected things will be requesting support.
entries.subject: Connected things requesting support

entries.quote: By 2020, autonomous software agents outside of human control will participate in five percent of all economic transactions.
entries.subject: Autonomous software agents in the economy
entries.metric: share of economic transactions with autonomous software agents

entries.quote: By 2018, more than 3 million workers globally will be supervised by a "robo-boss."
entries.subject: Robo-bosses

entries.quote: By year-end 2018, 20 percent of smart buildings will have suffered from digital vandalism.
entries.subject: Smart building digital vandalism
entries.metric: share of smart buildings suffering digital vandalism

entries.quote: By 2018, 45 percent of the fastest-growing companies will have fewer employees than instances of smart machines.
entries.subject: Smart machines in fast-growing companies
entries.metric: share of fastest-growing companies with fewer employees than smart machines

entries.quote: By year-end 2018, customer digital assistant will recognize individuals by face and voice across channels and partners.
entries.subject: Customer digital assistants with face and voice recognition

entries.quote: By 2018, two million employees will be required to wear health and fitness tracking devices as a condition of employment.
entries.subject: Mandatory employee fitness trackers
entries.metric: employees required to wear health and fitness trackers

entries.quote: By 2020, smart agents will facilitate 40 percent of mobile interactions, and the postapp era will begin to dominate.
entries.subject: Smart agents and the post-app era
entries.metric: share of mobile interactions facilitated by smart agents

entries.quote: Through 2020, 95 percent of cloud security failures will be the customer's fault
entries.subject: Cloud security failures
entries.metric: share of cloud security failures that are the customer's fault
